lines.text: Asaph says the nations have invaded God's inheritance, defiled His holy temple, and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
The bodies of God's servants were given as food to the fish of the sea, and no one buries the dead.
Israel's neighbors scorn them, and Asaph asks God to pour out His wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge Him.
Asaph asks God to help and atone for their sins for His name's sake, so the nations will not ask where their God is.
Asaph asks God to hear the captives' groans, and His people, the branches of His vine, will thank Him forever.
